notifications.comment: Set enabled=true and copy notifications.sample.json to notifications.json in the repo root

feedback.comment: post_to_launchpad: post the triage report as a comment on the Launchpad bug. Requires OAuth 1.0a credentials. Run once to obtain tokens: python3 -c "from launchpadlib.launchpad import Launchpad; lp = Launchpad.login_with('octavia-triage-agent', 'production', version='devel'); print('LAUNCHPAD_ACCESS_TOKEN=' + lp.credentials.access_token.key); print('LAUNCHPAD_ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET=' + lp.credentials.access_token.secret)"

context.comment: Context files are read before each AI call. Learnings are appended after notable outcomes. rules_file is read-only (agents never write it).

comment_branches: Branch patterns to check for the introducing commit. Wildcards supported (e.g. stable/* matches all stable branches). Only these branches will be checked.
